8.text: 🇷🇺 Video of grandfather's wartime heroism inspires marine to join special military operation A video depicting the heroic actions of a grandfather during wartime motivated a Russian marine to enlist in the special military operation. The footage, shared widely online, highlighted personal sacrifice and patriotism. The marine cited the video as a key factor in his decision to serve. Source: RIA Novosti

9.text: 🔥 Russian strikes hit dual-use warehouse and energy infrastructure in Ukraine Russia's Armed Forces continue carrying out group strikes on logistics centers, port and energy infrastructure of Ukraine used in the interests of the Ukrainian Armed Forces. Among the targets hit were a warehouse storing dual-use goods and energy facilities. • Targets included logistics centers, port and energy infrastructure • A warehouse storing dual-use goods was struck • Strikes continue as part of ongoing group operations Source: TASS

5.text: ⚠️ Nearly 80 Ukrainian drones destroyed over Bryansk region in 24 hours Russia's defense ministry reported that almost 80 Ukrainian drones were destroyed over Bryansk region during a 24-hour period. No further details were provided about damage or casualties on the ground. Source: RIA Novosti
